description: Machine session state. Provider-neutral: every agent (Claude, Codex, Gemini, or any other) and every human reads this before governed work. Update it at end of session and point active_handoff at the newest handoff.
next_allowed_move: COMMIT_STEWARD is authorized to create exactly one local commit containing the reviewed 67-path P4-A2 FREEZE / CLOSED_BOUNDED set; no amend, push, deployment or P4-A3 batching. After that distinct commit lands, ORCHESTRATOR may open P4-A3 at INTAKE only under the operator's delegated decision authority. commit_discipline: Commit and push to origin main as soon as each roadmap tranche is complete and gates pass. Do not batch multiple tranches into one commit. Commit message must name the tranche id and verification result. See history_index for the full historical commit-discipline record and its named example commits.
blocked_work: Restating P4-A/P3-B/Phase 3 bounded closure as application-level AI wiring, durable accounting, production provider integration, RAG, deployment or production readiness.

Any P4-A2 BUILD by the current ORCHESTRATOR/REVIEWER, any worker path outside the exact Work Order ceiling, or any worker-created completion review. Implementation must be performed by a separate IMPLEMENTATION_WORKER and returned for independent review.

Any hidden-Core or workspace-root mutation outside the exact CVF-CORE-REFRESH-2026-08-20 Work Order. The fresh 2026-08-20 authority permits only its sanctioned reconciler, declared root effects, binding regeneration, evidence and bounded rollback.
